blocks.html: The data to set the rules for tax rates.

types.name: SetTaxRatesRulesWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to set the rules for tax rates.

children.name: tax_rate_ids
children.description: The IDs of the tax rates to set their rules.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules to create for the tax rates.

children.name: reference
children.description:
The snake-case name of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `product`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: reference_id
children.description:
The ID of the record of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `prod_123`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: created_by
children.description:
Who created the tax rate rule. For example, the ID of the
user that created it.
